rerun.detail: Its harness, scorer, extractor, supplement ruleset and render receipt ship in this folder byte for byte, as its prereg pins them. The 60 rendered PDFs and their manifest do not: the PDFs are rendered from public Peppol samples whose publisher restricts redistributing modified copies, and the manifest names the authors' folders. The run also called an engine build that a build of today's source does not reproduce.

blind_basis: PREREG.sha256 holds the prereg's sha256 with no time of its own; the time 2026-10-03T09:18:31Z was added to it on 2026-10-05 from the list's file-system time. The prereg says it was written after the corpus was rendered (corpus/render-receipt.json records 09:15:26Z) and before any extraction or engine run on it. The list, the added time and the prereg are the authors' own, and the corpus and its planted defects were made by the authors
